headline: Evening wind-down: 2-3 drops after cleansing & toning
subhead: PM use: start every alternate day, then after 2 weeks of usage, use it everyday.
proof_points: RonaCare Salicylic Acid Extra Pure from Merck, Germany
footnote: 4 out of 5 stars from 1,969 reviews on beminimalist.co, captured 2026-10-02
layout_description: Left column: large strength figure and active name, then headline, subhead and up to three proof points; the AI-generated person scene (person_prompt) is the human cue and carries the AI-GENERATED — ILLUSTRATIVE mark top-right; real pack shot composited in the right 45%; rating line in the footnote band, CTA bottom-left.
image_prompt: Empty background scene only: a quiet evening bathroom wall in off-white tile, warm soft lamp light from the upper left, a faint shadow gradient towards the lower right. Off-white, soft natural light, few props, clinical minimal style. Square 1080x1080. Keep the right 45% of the frame as an empty clear space, evenly lit, reserved for a pack photo placed later, and keep the left 50% calm and low-detail, reserved for copy added later. No product, no bottle, no packaging, no text, no letters, no logos, no people, no faces, no skin, no hands.
adaptation_notes: Angle: situation. The moment is the PM routine the page states (F12 after cleansing & toning, F13 'When to use: PM' and the alternate-day start), shown as an evening wind-down; no result is implied. Kept: in-use moment (Foxtale), a single use-moment headline (Chemist at Play). Dropped: '10-minute fix', de-tan and brightening promises, '#1 daily duo', and every acne, blackhead and oil outcome in F2/F3/F10. The person is AI-generated (High risk, labelled); a real application photo would lower the risk. Rating in the footnote slot.

blend_sources.took: in-use moment as the visual cue
headline that names one use moment

person_prompt: A man in his late 20s with a medium-brown skin tone at a bathroom basin in the evening, wearing a plain grey t-shirt, damp hair pushed back after washing his face, a plain towel over one shoulder; he is pressing a few clear drops onto his cheek with his fingertips and looking into the mirror with a relaxed expression; warm soft lamp light from the upper left, off-white tiled wall behind, shallow depth of field, natural unretouched skin with visible pores and nothing implying a result, framed so he sits slightly left of centre with calm space to his right. No product, bottle, dropper, tube, jar or packaging anywhere in frame; no text, no letters, no logos, no brand names.

verdict.label: Ready for human review
verdict.detail: No blocking or must-fix issues found. This is a pre-screen, not an approval: brand and legal sign-off is still required.

findings.message: A time-bound result needs a study of that duration, with the qualifier shown on the creative.
findings.fix: Keep the timeframe only if it comes from a study you can cite, and put the qualifier in the footnote (e.g. '*Consumer perception study, 4 weeks'). Otherwise remove the timeframe.
findings.note: Wording appears on the product page (F13). Severity lowered one step: the brand has published it, but a reviewer must still confirm substantiation is on file.
